Manager Reports checkpoint

Current PR #4 head: 31b1d236fd4217d77ce176efdf950da730e7325c
Current main: 08cb7b855749ce7a10c8aa491d8dbd1fbc910387
Vercel: Ready.

Implemented:
- new Manager Reports surface
- weekly, monthly and project views
- evidence prefilled from real work_items, submissions, work_sessions, objectives and visible projects
- drillable completed-work, submissions, overdue-work and attendance-day figures
- completed-work trend line
- completed-by-project bars
- work-status composition donut
- attendance activity heat map
- every visual/metric opens underlying rows or the underlying project
- objective status is shown separately from task completion; task counts never infer objective achievement
- Manager narrative and challenges/context fields
- Print / save PDF uses the browser print path
- Reports added to Manager navigation and App routing only; Staff/Admin navigation unchanged

Submission is deliberately withheld because live database inspection found three persistence issues:

1. report_periods and reports are both empty in production today. A Manager cannot create a report record until Administration opens a matching period.

2. reports currently has UNIQUE (period_id, scope, unit_id, profile_id, project_id). PostgreSQL treats NULL values as distinct under this constraint. For a normal unit report, profile_id and project_id are NULL, so concurrent inserts can create duplicate unit reports for the same period. Client-side check-then-insert is not a safe integrity boundary.

Recommended database fix: a collision-safe unique rule for report identity, e.g. a NULLS NOT DISTINCT unique index or scope-specific partial unique indexes.

3. rpt_write is an ALL policy and does not make submitted/confirmed reports immutable. A Manager who can write a unit report can currently update a submitted report directly. That conflicts with the architecture's audit/reversibility principle.

Recommended fix: drafts editable by legitimate Manager/Admin; submitted reports immutable to Manager; corrections should create a new version or explicit forward correction, not silently edit history.

Additional structural limitation:
- reports stores narrative/status but no evidence snapshot or report sections. If a submitted report simply re-queries live work later, its figures can change after submission. For an auditable report, submission needs an immutable evidence snapshot/section payload or child rows storing the factual figures/row references at submission time.
- Manager spec also asks for confirm/correct + narrative/challenges. Narrative can use the existing column, but challenges/corrections need an explicit persisted structure if they must survive as separate sections.
- No report AI Edge Function exists yet, so AI interpretation is correctly not connected.

Until those are fixed, the screen provides a factual live preview and printable output but does not pretend report submission is safe.

No migrations were created by the Manager branch. Claude should own the report-persistence migration.

Locked homepage decisions:
- Home is a command centre, not a filing cabinet.
- Return behaviour is designed around freshness, progress, clear next action and role relevance — not gamification.
- Visuals must accelerate meaning: restrained status colour, progress where a real denominator exists, mini trends, timelines/calendar strips, simple composition visuals, strong hierarchy. No decorative charts.
- Common homepage hierarchy: context → needs attention → pulse/movement → progress/status → upcoming → recent activity → quick actions.
- Every meaningful count/visual must drill to its source records/canonical screen.
- Staff, Manager, Administration & HR and Group Pastor have distinct role-specific home architectures.
- Manager Home preserves waiting on you → team today → stuck both ways → own work → projects needing attention → current-week/upcoming.
- Manager Home may adapt emphasis by the unit's actual work types/configuration without hard-coding Media or Facilities.
- Admin Home becomes organisation control-room altitude: escalations, reporting, HR verification/completeness, office pulse, expiring records, attendance/leave and administrative actions.
- Group Pastor Home stays high-level: ministry objectives/results, major projects, escalations, reporting coverage, quiet/falling factual trends, office presence at aggregate altitude, delivery + cost.
- Recent activity is factual, permission-scoped and shown only where useful.
- No score/ranking/badges/streaks or manipulative engagement.
- Empty/quiet states reduce clutter rather than showing zero-card walls.
- Phone/laptop must preserve the same information hierarchy.
- Codex build order: Manager Home first, Staff Home second; do not touch Claude-owned Admin/Executive screens unless ownership is explicitly handed over or Claude is available.

No database/schema work was added. Backend-dependent Routine/HR/Messages/typed-work states must not be faked in the client.

commit.message:
Build formal Manager project close submission

Adds the five-part unit and overall close flow against the deployed project-close contract, including objective verdicts, deliverable evidence, per-currency cost snapshots, challenges, lessons, and non-filer readiness.

Connect Project Detail to formal close flow

Replaces the unavailable Project Close placeholder with the deployed five-part close submission component while leaving project discussion deferred to the unified Messages model.

Show checklist corrections on returned work

Staff now see the exact checklist points selected by their manager's return review, alongside the existing return comment and re-opened checklist state.

Merge migration 025 contract into Manager branch

Bring the Project Close authority and reversibility contract into PR #4 before exposing the close/reopen lifecycle.

Complete reversible Manager Project Close lifecycle

Use the database version generator for every close, expose the formal close_project action after an overall close, and let the lead unit reopen a closed project with a recorded reason while preserving all close history.

Require a new overall close after project reopen

A reopened project now records the latest reopen event and will not expose the final close action against an older close report. The lead must submit a new version before closing again.

Build factual Manager Reports preview

Adds weekly, monthly and project report views prefilled from recorded work, submissions, objectives and attendance, with drillable figures and the required visual layers. Submission remains deliberately blocked until report persistence is collision-safe.

Add Reports to Manager navigation

Expose the new Manager Reports surface in the existing Manager navigation without changing Staff or Admin navigation behavior.

Route Manager Reports through the shared app shell

Add only the Manager Reports import and route to the shared App file, preserving existing Staff and Admin routing.

Reconcile Manager PR with current reporting main

Preserve the Manager routing/navigation from PR #4 while bringing in Administration Reporting, the current report database contract, and migration-history documentation from main.

Connect Manager Reports to durable report persistence

Wire open periods, collision-safe draft saves, evidence references, immutable submission snapshots, version history and correction drafts into the existing Manager Reports surface. Submitted reports render from frozen evidence rather than live-changing data.

Make Manager report history selectable by period

Allow managers to reopen prior weekly/monthly report periods as well as explicit project periods, and prevent opening a second correction while a correction draft already exists.

Add the twenty-second staff self-created task path

Staff can now record agreed project work directly from My Work with a project, due time and required completion checklist. It is assigned only to themselves, stored as self_created, and appears without a manager approval step.

Show project committed cost in Manager Finance

Project rows now show planned, approved-but-unspent committed, and actual amounts per currency without conversion or cross-currency totals.

Fix Manager Reports team membership query

unit_memberships has no active column; remove the invalid filter so report attendance evidence can load.

Fix Manager Calendar team membership query

unit_memberships has no active column; remove the invalid filter so team leave can load on the calendar.

Make staff self-created task insert compatible with RLS

The staff insert policy allows creation but INSERT RETURNING is blocked by the work read policy during the same statement. Generate the UUID in the client, insert without RETURNING, then attach the required checklist by that ID.

Load every unit membership for dual-role staff

Stop choosing an arbitrary first membership. Keep all unit roles, restore the user's selected unit, and default to a manager membership when available so the panel can switch units safely.

Switch the active unit without mixing roles

Use the selected membership to change unit context, reset open Manager overlays, and persist the choice for dual-role staff.

Add the dual-role unit switcher to shared navigation

People with more than one unit membership can choose their current unit and role. Admin and Executive navigation is unchanged.

Collapse Manager mobile navigation to five tabs

Match the Manager spec on phones: Home, Work, Team, Projects and More. Calendar, Finance, Reports and Me now live behind the More tray while laptop sidebar navigation remains unchanged.

Keep self-certified Manager work in My record

Count self-certified work as finished, and use honest denominators for on-time and first-time-approval figures so unreviewed Manager work does not distort either measure.

Expose unit switching on mobile too

Render the same dual-role unit context above the mobile panel so a manager who switches into a staff unit can still switch back.

Style the mobile unit context selector

Keep the selector in normal mobile flow and hide it on laptop where the sidebar selector is already available.
Keep project attendance evidence attributable
Label project attendance evidence precisely

Make Manager Finance headline figures explain themselves

Each currency amount in the unit position now opens the budget, spending or approved-request rows behind it. Remaining shows all three inputs instead of presenting an unexplained derived number.

Keep Manager Projects inside the selected unit

A dual-role user may legitimately see projects from several memberships at the database level. Filter the Manager panel to the current unit and reject direct detail access to a project outside that unit context.

Keep Manager Calendar project dates in the selected unit

Dual-role users can see projects from multiple memberships. Calendar project milestones now include only projects led by or participating in the active unit.

Keep Manager Finance projects in the selected unit

Filter project rows to the active unit so a dual-role user does not see another membership's projects while viewing this unit's finance.

Keep Manager Reports projects in the selected unit

Filter report project choices to the active unit instead of every project visible through any membership on a dual-role account.

Keep assignment choices in the selected unit

A dual-role manager now sees only projects involving the active unit and only that unit's objectives when giving out work.

Show only approved leave on Manager Calendar

An escalated request is still awaiting Administration, so it must not appear as confirmed team leave.

Open ministry calendar entries in place

Ministry and unit activities now open a factual detail sheet with timing, location, notes, the active unit's requirement, and cancelled state instead of being dead calendar buttons.

Resume an existing Project Close draft on retry

If a close submission fails after creating its draft, retry now refreshes and reuses that draft instead of silently creating another version. Submitted close versions remain untouched.

Open team members from Manager Home drill-down

The people behind presence, leave and not-started figures now open the existing Person Detail view instead of ending at a static row.
Connect Manager Home team drill-down to Person Detail

Finish Manager sub-team maintenance

Managers can now rename and reorder work lanes. Removing a lane first asks where its attached work should go, moves that work without changing historical references, then removes the lane.

Carry work unit ownership into Project Close

Include unit_id on project work so a unit return can prefill only deliverables owned by that unit while the overall close can still use project-wide work.

Scope Project Close deliverables correctly

Unit returns now prefill only completed/self-certified work owned by that unit. The overall project close still uses completed work across participating units.

Open team leave from Manager Calendar

Approved leave entries now open the underlying leave facts—person, kind and dates—instead of redirecting to an unrelated session-history view.

Add CEAC identity to printed Manager Reports

Browser print/PDF now carries a simple CEAC and unit header so the temporary PDF output is identifiable outside the app.

Clean the CEAC OS print surface

Hide app navigation and sheets in print/PDF output while keeping report evidence, charts and rows visible.

Make Project Close history usable

Managers can now open preserved overall close versions and the latest unit return to see the submitted deliverables, objective verdicts, per-currency cost snapshot, challenges and next-time note.

Show every submitted unit-return version

Unit return history now mirrors overall Project Close history instead of exposing only the latest submitted unit return.

Count only tasks and deliverables as completed on Team

Keep CEAC's completion metric from turning closed cases, requests, decisions or meeting outcomes into output numbers.

Use CEAC's completion definition on Person Detail

Completion, on-time and first-time approval figures now count only Tasks and Deliverables, not every kind of closed work.

Use CEAC's completion definition in My Record

Finished, assigned/self-created, on-time and first-time approval figures now count only Tasks and Deliverables.

Use CEAC's completion definition in Manager Reports

The submitted completed-work count and trend now count only Tasks and Deliverables. Other work kinds remain visible in composition and underlying work without being turned into a completion metric.

Show manager feedback in the staff member's own record

Feedback written from Manager Person Detail is now visible to the person it is about, preserving CEAC's rule that nothing about a person is hidden from them.
